items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Chubby Jackson was the bass player in the band

ctx.x: He was conducting and playing when he got through -- but he was mostly conducting. He also was in the Happy Hour or something, a club in Minneapolis. And that's where we picked up Oscar Pettiford. Chubby Jackson was the bass player in the band, and he liked Oscar... He was really the one that was responsible for Oscar coming to New York -- Chubby Jackson.
Who picked Oscar Pettiford up, Charlie Barnet or Lips?
